title: Refund Promised by Previous Agent - Now Denied
agent_context: Customer was promised a refund by a previous agent but is now being denied due to policy. Apologize for conflicting info, check internal notes quickly, then give a clear decision with the best allowed alternative and escalation option.

raw_content.initial_message: Your agent promised me a full refund yesterday. Now you’re saying no? Are you guys scamming me?
raw_content.context: Customer outside the refund window based on policy, but claims a previous agent promised a refund. Policy: do not blame colleague; apologize for confusion; check internal notes/order details; if refund not allowed, offer best alternative (warranty/credit/expedited repair) and offer supervisor escalation. Provide clear next update time after checking notes.

learning_objectives: Repair trust when prior info conflicts
Offer best allowed solution + escalation path
correct_sop_steps: Acknowledge frustration and apologize for conflicting information
Confirm details and commit to checking account notes/order history
Avoid blaming colleague; use neutral language ('I’ll review what was shared')
If refund is allowed per notes/policy, confirm and share timeline; if not allowed, explain policy softly and offer best alternative
Offer escalation to supervisor if customer requests or remains upset
Set a clear next update time and follow-through
common_mistakes: Saying 'the other agent was wrong' or blaming them
Arguing about what the customer was told

must_demonstrate: Clear outcome with alternative + escalation option
bonus_points: Sets and meets a short update cadence
sticky_notes: KEY: Trust repair first; then verify notes.
TRAP: Don’t blame a colleague — customer interprets it as incompetence.
HINT: Commit to a short review window and return with a decision + alternative.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will calm down if you apologize for confusion and quickly verify notes with a clear next update time
